date_note: Date of Rakuten Securities' own notice; it detected possible unauthorized access on 16 Nov, and says the information may have leaked on 11 Nov. ScanNetSecurity reported it on 20 Nov.
title: Rakuten Securities: data of up to about 11.25 million accounts may have leaked after unauthorized access
summary: Rakuten Securities said on 17 November that it detected possible unauthorized third-party access to part of its systems on 16 November. Its investigation found that information in a test-environment system may have leaked on 11 November: up to about 4.47 million accounts with personal and financial details, and up to about 11.25 million accounts with branch/customer code and login ID only. The cause is still under investigation.
plain: Rakuten Securities says customer data from a test system may have leaked, for up to about 11.25 million accounts. It is still investigating how.
exec: A major Japanese broker says data of up to about 11.25 million accounts may have leaked; the cause is still under investigation.
action: Rakuten Securities customers should follow the company's notice and watch for phishing that uses the account details involved; the company says it will notify affected customers individually.

sources.name: Rakuten Securities notice, 17 Nov 2026 (apology and notice on possible leak of customer information)

validation.note: The company's own notice (17 Nov) and ScanNetSecurity (20 Nov) agree on dates and both up-to figures; the cause is not stated in either.
